RecipeSearch 1.3

FRMC ports the RecipeSearch 1.3 search-tree implementation into source and
adapts the Forge integration code from Fast-Recipe-Search-forge-1.20 to FRMC's
package and Mixin configuration. FRMC does not bundle the RecipeSearch JAR.
The complete license text is in Fast-Recipe-Search-LICENSE.txt and is also
packaged as META-INF/licenses/RecipeSearch-LICENSE.txt in the FRMC artifact.
